text:
tess: quick flag - we're targeting a short early-morning patch to swap in the quant kernel hotfix (matmul alignment) + drop-in shim. window 04:00-05:00 UTC. plan: 2% canary -> 15% -> 100%. small footprint.

omar: please include the matmul regression test and the tail-latency probe in the preflight. last time tail regressed on x86-thermal.

deploybot: [scheduled] release created: rb/matmul-hotfix-2026-03-23 (canary 2%). start=04:00 UTC notify #eng-runtime

release-czar: I'll own the release notes and the customer impact blurb. what's the fallback variant?

tess: fallback -> engine:matmul-compat-v0. rollback criteria: error-rate +3% OR p99+150ms for 5m. pin TTL=60m.

sre-oncall: I'm onwatch. PD policy active. will page on any SLO breach.

omar: added preflight job: matmul-smoke and tail-probe across 4 staging pools.

deploybot: command: /release start rb/matmul-hotfix-2026-03-23 --canary=2 --ttl=60m --notify #eng-runtime

release-czar: draft note: "rb/matmul-hotfix-2026-03-23: matmul alignment fix for int8 kernels; no model behavior change expected. Fallback: engine:matmul-compat-v0. Rollback triggers: error-rate/p99 thresholds." publishing before start.

deploybot: [running] canary at 2% started 04:00 UTC. metrics: /metrics/release/rb/matmul-hotfix-2026-03-23

sre-oncall: seeing small p95 increase +30ms at +5m on thermal nodes. holding watch.

omar: p95 seems to settle at +15ms after 8m. nothing to abort for.

release-czar: note to support: please don't auto-escalate unless PD fires. user impact likely minimal.

tess: plan to move to 15% at +20m if stable.

deploybot: [status] 15% shift started at 04:25 UTC.

sre-oncall: no PD triggered. brief p99 blip to 160ms for 3m after 15% shift but returned to baseline. marking as transient.

omar: good to go for full promote in 15m. will run an additional matmul tail probe at 04:40 UTC.

deploybot: [done] rollout completed 04:50 UTC. build sha: sha256:3a2b1c4d5e6f7a8b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d

tess: clearing pin now. thanks all. closing thread.
